verified: Fraunhofer ISE's Energy-Charts data, as reported by pv magazine, shows 100.2 TWh of German solar generation by the morning of Nov. 27, split into 80.6 TWh of EEG-supported grid feed-in, 2.6 TWh from other PV systems and 16.9 TWh of self-consumption, against 90 TWh for the whole of 2025.
unconfirmed: the final full-year 2026 total, since the 100.2 TWh figure is a year-to-date reading taken in late November; the report also relies on a single data platform and does not give an independently audited breakdown, and the mid-November projection of the milestone by the solar and battery trade group BSB rested on the same Fraunhofer ISE numbers.

verified: pv magazine 援引 Fraunhofer ISE 的 Energy-Charts 数据，确认截至 11 月 27 日上午光伏累计发电 100.2 TWh，并给出 80.6 TWh、2.6 TWh、16.9 TWh 的分项及各类电源的年内发电量排序。
unconfirmed: 2026 年尚未结束，100.2 TWh 是截至 11 月 27 日的年内累计值而非最终全年数据；德国太阳能与电池经济协会（BSB）11 月中旬称德国“即将达到”该里程碑，同样依据该所数据，未经过第三方独立核算；报道未提供新增装机容量或相关政策变动细节。

titles.en: Germany's solar output passes 100 TWh in a year for the first time
titles.zh: 德国光伏年发电量首次突破100 TWh
